parity_extension.start: STA and APSTA share scan/hop lifecycle. Start calls disconnect and delays50ms; no automatic restoration of old association. Application must suspend reconnect/unrelated scans. SDK cannot atomically arbitrate ownership against unrelated scan callers.

Plaintext AirKiss password+token short/full block CRC, all password lengths0..64. V2 cache SSID with declared length/BSSID CRC; password/reserved CRC/decryption unchanged. Prior conflicting received fields block completion; completed results immutable. Keyed AirKiss remains full-message.
